claims.statement: Every loop run shares one closed-loop lifecycle (planning → running → verifying → ready_for_human_merge → completed, plus blocked/escalated/cancelled/interrupted): the loop never merges itself — the no_automatic_merge gate is a structural constant that always passes, and completeLoopRun is the only terminal transition, throwing LOOP_HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED without an explicit human_approval_ref and refusing a cancelled run, any failed or unknown gate, or incomplete non-superseded leases. The single operator-armed relaxation is the revocable earned-auto-merge lane for verified test-only loop PRs, which is not a loop gate.

LoopService is a facade over focused sub-services: LoopDiscoveryService (findings), LoopLifecycleService (continue/retry/split lease and worktree creation), LoopWorkerExecutorService (maker/checker execution and gates), LoopVerificationService (completion gates/certification), LoopBudgetService (budgets and failure-threshold escalation), WorktreeManager (worktrees), and KnowledgeRuntimeService (learning closure). The operator API surface is createLoopRoutes: writes POST /loops/start, /runs/:id/continue|retry|split|verify|execute-maker|execute-worker|execute-checker|run-checks|stop (create:task) and /runs/:id/checker-verdict|security-verdict|complete (approve:task, where the reviewer is the authenticated req.user), plus draft-PR/dependency-lane/auto-merge read and re-enable routes.

The loop fleet's named loops are finding sources over one maker→checker pipeline: the Doc Drift loop scans markdown for TODO/FIXME markers, npm-run references missing from package.json scripts, and broken relative links; the Self-Improvement loop synthesizes one bound self_improvement_objective finding from a goal's objective (objective_mode, requiring goal_id, file taken from the proposal's grounding artifact) instead of scanning; and the GitHub path imports issues as untrusted inbox work items (execution_started: false) while pull_request events auto-start a repo-maintenance-loop run via target_finding on a stable anchor file.

Seven closed-loop contracts in LOOP_CONTRACTS (doc-drift, repo-maintenance, skill-quality, mcp-connector-validation, security-regression, okf-synchronization, overwatch-policy-drift) declare per-loop actions_allowed, actions_forbidden, verification, escalation and stop_conditions; createPlan stamps every finding with requires_human_approval_before_merge and a named maker/checker role pair.

continueLoopRun is the single lease-creation path: it refuses paused/escalated/over-budget/failed-gate runs, creates an isolated git worktree per finding (branch agent/loop/<runId>-<finding>) with untracked-file snapshotting and path-traversal guards, writes .djimitflo/LOOP_WORK.md and ASSIGNMENT_PACKET.json, and inserts a maker lease with the requested runtime plus a checker lease that is always runtime 'manual'; high-risk runs additionally get a security_checker lease, also manual.

High-risk classification is multi-source and two-sided: text risk (the run's risk_class, the linked goal's risk_class, a finding marked category 'security', or sensitive keywords auth/secret/token/policy/infra/… in finding text) plus changed-files risk (the paths a maker actually changed, classified by the same sensitive-content rule and a high-risk path list); the effective risk is their max and can only raise a run to high, driving the security_checker lease requirement (created at lease time from text risk, or after the fact via ensureChangedFilesSecurityChecker from changed files) and the security_checker_verdict gate.

executeMaker enforces gates that bound blast radius: maker_runtime_exit_zero, diff_under_threshold (diff_max_lines default 200, clamped 1–2000, with a 400-line TEST_ONLY_DIFF_MAX allowance when every changed file is a test), token_budget, runtime_warning_gate, and the structural no_automatic_merge; it fail-closes on an unavailable or drifted runtime contract (RUNTIME_CONTRACT_DRIFTED, recording a fail manifest and failing any lease it left stuck running), repairs and re-registers a deploy-unlinked worktree before execution (worktree_repaired event), and restores a package-lock.json rewrite that lacks a package.json change as install noise (maker_lockfile_restored event) before computing the diff; recorded changed_files are the tracked diff plus untracked files, always excluding package-lock.json and .djimitflo/ control files.

Worker runtime children run with default-deny permission bypass (skip_permissions only honored when RUNTIME_ALLOW_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=true) and receive only an allowlisted environment — the server's own secrets are never forwarded — extended only by an explicit operator RUNTIME_ENV_PASSTHROUGH list.

executeChecker enforces reviewer independence and dispatch rules: the checker lease must be prepared and linked to a completed maker, receives its own worktree (branched from the maker's) that must be realpath-distinct from every other lease's worktree (CHECKER_WORKTREE_NOT_INDEPENDENT), a manual lease cannot be dispatched without an explicit runtime (CHECKER_RUNTIME_REQUIRED, never silently as mock), and a continuation must reuse the originally dispatched runtime (CHECKER_RUNTIME_MISMATCH); the assignment packet the reviewer reads is trusted only while it still hashes to the sha256 recorded at lease creation, else the daemon's content-addressed copy (or a withheld notice) is used and the tamper is recorded.

Checker verdicts are fail-closed: stdout is scanned for the last valid accepted/needs_revision/rejected/insufficient_evidence JSON object (with one repaired closing brace), with anything absent or unrecognized becoming insufficient_evidence and an explicit verdict never re-interpreted; a checker whose worktree git status is not clean fails the read_only contract (a lockfile-only rewrite is restored first); and both the checker and security checker prompts explicitly state the verdict is not human approval or permission to merge.

reviewEvidence requires full runtime proof for runtime verdicts (exit 0, not timed out or cancelled, runtime_verdict accepted, read_only_contract_passed, valid runtime contract, adapter matching the lease runtime, and an existing stdout log on disk — a since-disappeared log makes the gate unknown rather than fail), while manual leases pass only with an attestation of reviewer_type 'human' plus the authenticated reviewer_user_id and a reason (or a pre-cutoff legacy attestation labelled legacy_unverified_identity); a manual submission therefore cannot relabel a rejected runtime verdict as accepted.

verifyLoopRun evaluates twelve gates — run_not_cancelled, maker_completion, maker_checker_separation, worktree_isolation, assignment_file_present, diff_threshold_all_makers, checker_verdict, tests_lint_typecheck (at least one check must really have run and passed; an all-skipped set fails), security_checker_verdict (skipped unless high-risk by text or changed files), auto_approved_scope (a J5 auto-approved maker may have changed only its single approved file), objective_scope (an objective-mode maker may change only its finding file), and no_automatic_merge — on a three-valued scale where fail is a durable failure and unknown is insufficient evidence that blocks certification without being recorded as a failed invariant; superseded makers and their reviewers are excluded so a fully reviewed retry can certify, gym and synthetic-PR runs skip the change-loop artifact gates, and completeLoopRun is the only terminal transition, requiring human_approval_ref and refusing any fail or unknown gate.

runDeterministicChecks runs npm scripts (default test/lint/type-check) in the maker worktree with a per-script timeout (default 120 s, clamped to 600 s) and a 5 MB capture cap written under the evidence root at <run>/checks/<lease>/, first running the worktree's npm ci when a lockfile is present but node_modules is not, and records a script absent from package.json as fail with reason missing_script (an all-skipped run can no longer verify); any failure flips the maker lease to failed, moves the run to blocked, and feeds failing stderr tails (last 1000 chars, missing-script excluded) into the self-improvement pipeline via SelfImprovementService.generateFromBuildErrors as a best-effort side effect that can never affect the checks result.

Daemon-side knobs: daemonCheckOptions scopes deterministic checks via LOOP_DAEMON_CHECK_SCRIPTS (or an extra repo's own EXTRA_REPO_CHECKS_<SLUG>, default test) and LOOP_DAEMON_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS (clamped to 600 s); daemonReviewerTimeoutMs honors LOOP_REVIEWER_TIMEOUT_MS with a 300 s default calibrated from production reviewer timings (45–119 s; 2/7 reviews hit the old fixed 120 s) and a 900 s ceiling; daemonMakerTimeoutMs gives the mutation lane the executor maximum of 600 s and other makers LOOP_MAKER_TIMEOUT_MS (default 300 s, capped 600 s); the maker diff cap is lane-specific — mutation lane 400 lines, dead-code lane 2000, finding-fix lane 30 (FINDING_FIX_DIFF_MAX), otherwise the 200 default.

escalateIfFailureThresholdExceeded counts failed maker leases plus checker/security_checker verdicts of needs_revision, rejected, or insufficient_evidence against a per-run threshold and sets the run status to escalated; continueLoopRun then fails closed with LOOP_ESCALATED_REQUIRES_HUMAN until an operator retries, splits, or cancels.

LoopDraftPrService (default off behind LOOP_AUTO_DRAFT_PR_ENABLED, requires GITHUB_REPOSITORY/GITHUB_TOKEN) turns a ready_for_human_merge/completed run into at most one GitHub draft PR per run (idempotent via metadata.pr_url): it pushes only the maker's real files (excluding node_modules symlinks and lockfile install noise) under a djimitflo-loop commit identity, passes the token only as a one-off http.extraheader never persisted to git config, targets the goal proposal's registered repo (an unregistered or remote-mismatched repo gets no PR), records the pushed commit as metadata.verified_head_sha for the auto-merge lane's head binding, consults the evidence-freshness read set (enforce mode skips opening and requests a re-check) and an optional open-draft throttle, and records a draft_pr_failed loop event instead of throwing on failure. The merge stays human; the draft PR is only the hand-off.

KnowledgeRuntimeService.closeLoop runs in a single transaction: it revalidates the run's current evidence (terminal reviewed status, not operator-paused, all non-superseded makers completed, accepted checker evidence per maker plus no invalid review evidence on any active reviewer, accepted security checker evidence for runs high-risk by text or changed files, at least one passing gate and none unresolved, non-empty trace spans/checkpoints/runner manifests) and returns status blocked with reasons creating nothing if any check fails; otherwise it runs a loop-learning eval with score delta versus the previous eval, writes a ReflectionCandidate and an operational-memory MemoryCandidate, creates a repair work item on regression (repo-maintenance-loop) or a skill-promotion work item on improvement (skill-quality-loop), persists one row in loop_learning_closures, and binds a linked verified self_improvements proposal to status evaluating with loop/eval/reflection evidence refs — rolling the whole transaction back if the proposal's stored evidence refs are malformed, and never marking a proposal applied or merging anything. Replaying a stored closure revalidates before returning it.

LoopDaemon polls the goal queue (GOAL_QUEUE_POLL_MS default 5 s, GOAL_MAX_CONCURRENT default 4), applies the fail-closed authorityGateForGoal per goal, and executeGoal runs decompose → start loop → continueLoopRun → execute maker (lane-tuned timeouts and diff caps: mutation 600 s/400 lines, dead-code 2000, finding-fix 30) → runDeterministicChecks (with one retry on blocked) → optional evolve siblings (LOOP_EVOLVE_ENABLED, test-gap/mutation-lane or metadata.evolve goals, fittest stays the only non-superseded maker) → optional automated checker (one reviewer retry on runtime give-out under LOOP_REVIEWER_RETRY_ENABLED; LOOP_REVIEWER_STRATEGY=bounded skips the security checker once the checker has no decisive verdict) → verify deferred while any reviewer is still running → verifyLoopRun → loop_completed bus event, outcome attribution, proposal recordOutcome(verified/regressed/infra_failed/no_change) and one deduplicated skill_outcomes row → learning closure and draft PR only on all-gates-strictly-pass → goal/run status update; goals with no findings are completed as no-ops, and a blocked closure is recorded as learning_closure_blocked.

Automated checker dispatch is a deliberate autonomy expansion: checker leases are always created runtime 'manual' (code review requires a human by design), so the daemon only dispatches them when LOOP_DAEMON_AUTOMATED_CHECKER_ENABLED=true (default off) — then the newest prepared reviewer for the maker that goes on (a retry's or the evolve winner's, never a superseded maker's), on the runtime the maker attempt actually used (the outage-fallback original runtime, or a local LOOP_DAEMON_MAKER_RUNTIME runtime when the maker ran remote), at daemonReviewerTimeoutMs; a completed reviewer is never dispatched twice and a failed or inapplicable dispatch is recorded, never swallowed. The security checker has its own flag LOOP_DAEMON_AUTOMATED_SECURITY_CHECKER_ENABLED, and the F2 checker-family arm (same vs cross model by goal-id hash on opencode) is assigned at dispatch for oracle-lane goals. The previously missing dispatch was the root cause of checker_verdict never passing and loop_learning_closures staying near-empty.

A worker whose execution is gated by the engine's approval policy waits rather than fails: LOOP_WORKER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED parks the goal blocked with an awaiting_approval record (blockForApproval stamps an auto_approved_scope on the lease first when a shadow rule auto-approves, so verification can later hold the diff to that one file), resumeApprovalBlockedGoals requeues the goal on the same run once the approval is decided and the engine task is terminal — executeViaEngine then returns the stored result instead of running the maker twice — denied/expired approvals fail the goal with a goal_failed event, proposal outcome, and a closing loop_completed bus event, and a reviewer lease still running defers verification (verify_deferred) rather than recording a false regressed outcome.

Loop run state is durable in SQLite (loop_runs with status/findings/plan/gates/next_actions/metadata, worker_leases, append-only loop_events) with on-disk evidence resolved by resolveEvidenceRoot — LOOP_EVIDENCE_ROOT when set, else DB_PATH-adjacent <dirname(DB_PATH)>/agent-evidence/agentic-control-loop-fleet because verification requires the evidence to outlive the container (prod 2026-09-24 lost /app/.data on every deploy), else the repo .data fallback for local dev — plus a markdown LOOP_STATE.md per run; orphaned worktrees are pruned past a grace period (LOOP_WORKTREE_MAX_AGE_HOURS, 24 h) and recoverInterruptedRuns marks crash-orphaned runs interrupted and their leases failed so they stop reporting as active (leases with a genuinely live child are left alone).

submitCheckerVerdict and submitSecurityVerdict drive the run forward on each verdict: an accepted verdict re-runs verifyLoopRun immediately, while any non-accepted verdict feeds escalateIfFailureThresholdExceeded with reason checker_verdict:<verdict> / security_checker_verdict:<verdict>; a manual lease additionally requires a manual_attestation (MANUAL_VERDICT_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED) whose recorded reviewer is the authenticated req.user plus a reason, never a free-text body string.

Earned auto-merge (loop-auto-merge.ts, LOOP_AUTO_MERGE_TEST_ONLY default off, 15-minute tick) is the one path that merges a loop PR without a human click: only a verified run's own draft PR (loop: title, loop author, head = the maker branch, matching repo, matching base) whose head sha equals metadata.verified_head_sha (recorded by the draft-PR service) or only GitHub-verified update-branch merges on top of it, with exclusively test-file changes (none deleted) within the maker's lane diff limit, a passing assertion-strength verdict, no CHANGES_REQUESTED review, green checks, and outside the deterministic 10% audit sample; act mode squash-merges with the verified sha one step per tick capped by LOOP_AUTO_MERGE_MAX_PER_DAY (default 10), and a revert commit, failed main checks at the merge commit, or settled merge-survival removal revokes the class until an operator re-enables it through POST /loops/auto-merge/re-enable (audited).

The pull_request webhook feeds the loop in both directions: the goal and repo-maintenance-loop run it auto-starts on a stable anchor file are bookkeeping, while GithubPrReviewService.startReview posts the outcome back as a PR comment and a djimitflo-review Check Run — Phase 1 a synchronous rule-based verdict by default, Phase 2 (GITHUB_PR_REVIEW_RUNTIME, off by default) a real LLM checker through executeChecker in a worktree at the PR head; the PR-review run's synthetic maker lease keeps the change-loop artifact gates skipped (the PR is the patch), and the auto-merge lane never counts the djimitflo-review status context toward green.
